clauses.title: Scope
clauses.text: 1. Scope — Covers the requirements for cast iron detachable joints to be used with asbestos cement pressure pipes (light duty) conforming to IS  9627:1980.*

clauses.title: Brinell Hardness
clauses.text: 3.2 Brinell Hardness — Not more than 215 HBs.

clauses.title: Hydrostatic test
clauses.text: 3.3 Hydrostatic test—May be carried out for collars only. The collars shall withstand the test pressure specified in Table 1 of IS 9627 : 1980 for 15 Seconds without showing any leakage, sweating or other defects.

clauses.title: Nominal Dia
clauses.text: 4.1 Nominal Dia — 50, 80, 100, 125, 150, 200 mm with classes 5 and 10 for each Dia. for flanges and collars. SUMMARY OF IS  12987 : 1991 CAST IRON DETACHABLE JOINTS FOR USE WITH ASBESTOS CEMENT PRESSURE PIPES (LIGHT DUTY) Note — Nominal  diameter of  detachable joint shall refer to the corresponding nominal diameter of the asbestos cement pressure pipes.

clauses.title: Coating shall not be
clauses.text: 5.1 Coating shall not be applied to any part unless its surface is clean, dry and free from rust

clauses.title: All cast iron parts
clauses.text: 5.2 All cast iron parts shall be coated externally and internally with the same material; the parts being preheated prior to total immersion in a bath containing a uniformly heated bituminous/tar or other suitable base. Note — Coal tar should not be used in cast iron detachable joints used with AC pipes for carrying potable water.

clauses.title: In all instances where
clauses.text: 5.3 In all instances where the coating material has a tar or similar base, it shall be smooth and tenacious and hard enough not to flow when exposed to a temperature of 66°C but not so brittle at a temperature of 0°C as to chip off when scribed lightly with a penknife. *Asbestos  cement pressure pipes (light duty). +Grey iron castings (fourth revision). For detailed information, refer to  IS   12987 : 1991 Specification for cast Iron detachable joints for use with asbestos cement pressure pipes (light duty).
